_comment: Bean fnqn. Sections whose words are mostly SAMPLE text, not the document speaking — the section analogue of image-verdicts.json, read by scripts/summaries.ts (the drafter is told to describe what the page exhibits and keep its guidance line, not summarise filler) and scripts/lsi.ts (not an index unit). Selected by MEASUREMENT, 2026-09-29: pages with >= 90 words of which >= 40% are not English (pyspellchecker). Six pages cleared it at 42-68%; the next page with real text was 18% (p24). Pages 20-22 were proposed by the LSI analysis and REJECTED here: their samples sit beside real guidance ('Recommended font size 10pts', 'Avoid combining red and green'), and p22's sample table is real framework text. Each page also carries a line or two of guidance, quoted in `saw` so it is not lost.

page-014.saw: Font guidance ('Consistent fonts across our communications help brand recognition'; News Gothic MT, DIN OT, PT Sans, Calibri with weights) followed by pseudo-Latin sample paragraphs set in each font ('Unt excerum sin nonsequ ...'). 47% of 232 words not English.

page-015.saw: Font specimens: Times New Roman and Minion Pro, 'Sample (8pt) leading 9.6pt', each followed by the same pseudo-Latin paragraph. 47% of 97 words not English.

page-028.saw: 'Margins and bleed — This is the minimum recommended margin and bleed' over a sample publication page filled with Latin-like filler ('a omniam ter unte teroximus ...'). 68% of 427 words not English.

page-029.saw: Cover sample: 'Spine must be minimum 3/8" W to print type/logo', title set in 12-point News Gothic MT, and a Lorem-ipsum publication blurb. 42% of 304 words not English.

page-030.saw: Cover sample, as p29 with the title in 12-point The Sans Bold; the same spine note and Lorem-ipsum blurb. 43% of 302 words not English.
